referencePolicy: Asset paths are relative to this catalog. Relative paths inside copied visualization assets resolve against their entry's referenceBase, matching the original collection contract. HTTPS NASA/SVS links are external provenance/optional imagery, not package dependencies.
integrityPolicy: Every SHA-256 and byte count describes exact UTF-8 LF file bytes. Collection publication digests, verified source evidence and master asset digests must all agree. No newline normalization or formatting exemption is applied during verification.
scientificCaveats: Dust uses selected three-hour means; rainfall, temperature and wind use selected one-hour means. None are daily/monthly averages or climatology.
No seasonal summary layers exist; seasonal catalog membership is included.
Different literal GEOS build labels remain separate; cross-build comparisons are blocked.
SVS 5669 is RELATED_CONTEXT for August 19 only, not registered numeric pixels.
